title: feat(types)!: UnifiedViewConfig.chart retires with a tombstone naming the spec's list chart block; the object-chart legacy-axis refusals stop calling the keys a list-view spelling (objectui#12063)
body:
Fixes #12063
Clause-②: no

Lane `domain:spec @ objectui`. Claim `6083287264`, amended by `6084083560` (patch round 1 adds `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`); ruling: triage `6082380722` (census first; with zero consumers the member retires with a tombstone naming the spec's list chart block; the three messages ride the same PR). Base: `main` at `2a48bd4`, which carries PR objectui#12060 (`0253416`). The first round's gates were read at head `ad25686`, and patch round 1's at head `dc8e887`. Written by a dispatched dev run of the PM seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CijGnfWLxTLUFcJkY2ouUw`.

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/types`, `designer.ts`: `UnifiedViewConfig.chart` retires.** The member declared the list-view chart's pre-ADR-0021 inline query (`chartType` beside `xAxisField`, `yAxisFields`, `aggregation`, `series`, `config`, `filter`). No route reads those axes since objectui#6152 round 15, and every list-view door refuses them by name. The member is now `chart?: never`. Its docblock names the remedy: the spec's list chart block, `ListChartConfig` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (the `chart` member of its `ListView`), `{ chartType, dataset, dimensions, values }`. The other `UnifiedViewConfig` members are untouched.
- **`@object-ui/types`, `zod/objectql.zod.ts`: the `object-chart` refusals of `xAxisField`, `yAxisFields` and `aggregation`** drop "is the list-view chart block's spelling". Each now opens "no `object-chart` reader consumes KEY". Each remedy is unchanged: `xAxis: { field: 'status' }`, `yAxis: [{ field: 'amount' }]`, `aggregate: { field, function, groupBy }` with its `function` list.
- **`@object-ui/types`, `objectql.ts` (patch round 1): the TypeScript twins of those three refusals.** The docblocks of `ObjectChartSchema.xAxisField`, `yAxisFields` and `aggregation` ship in the `.d.ts` and opened with the same clause ("the list-view chart block's spelling, read by no `object-chart` reader"). Each now opens "no `object-chart` reader consumes KEY". Each remedy sentence and each `@deprecated` line is unchanged. Nothing else in the file moves.
- **New pin:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/unified-view-config-chart-retired-12063.test.ts`.
  - TYPE rows, read by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: the member reads `undefined`; a sibling block does not (the helper can fail); an undeclared key reads `any` (why a deletion is no refusal); the remedy is the spec's own `ListView['chart']`. Three `@ts-expect-error` rows: the legacy block, a dataset-shaped block (the member retires whole, it is not narrowed) and a widened value.
  - RUNTIME rows, read by vitest: the remedy parses at the spec's `ListChartConfigSchema`, and the retired block's six axis keys are refused there by name (`unrecognized_keys`).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12063-unified-view-config-chart-retired.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/types`. objectui's version policy never declares `major`; the body states the break, the remedy table and the unmeasured consumers, and names the docblocks beside the three refusals.
- No pending changeset goes false: `git grep` over `.changeset/` for `UnifiedViewConfig`, the clause and `10608` answers exit 1 (no hits).

## Census (H1, H2): zero consumers, so the ruling's retire branch

Read on `2a48bd4` with `git grep`. Each scope is shown as files naming `UnifiedViewConfig` / control files naming `DashboardWidgetConfig`, `ListViewSchema` or `@object-ui/types`:

| scope | target | control |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| `packages/*/src` | 2 (`designer.ts`, `index.ts`) | 1419 |
| `apps/*/src` | 0 | 24 |
| tests (`**/__tests__/**`, `*.test.*`) | 0 | 128 / 156 |
| `docs` | 0 | 7 |
| `content/docs` | 0 | 102 |
| `examples` | 0 | 26 |
| `skills` | 0 | 7 |

The whole tracked tree has 4 hits: the declaration and one docblock mention in `designer.ts`, the re-export in `packages/types/src/index.ts`, and one `ROADMAP.md` checklist line that names the type, not `.chart`. Nothing reads `.chart` off the type.

**Published `.d.ts` reach (H2).** Radius measured:

- **The objectstack checkout** (`e148ca98`, read only): `git grep UnifiedViewConfig` exit 1, no hits; control `@object-ui/types` 39 files. No code file there imports from `@object-ui/types` at all; it is named only in prose.
- **Installed dependency trees.** Neither shared checkout has a `node_modules`. This worktree's pnpm store holds 1587 packages, among them the seven `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 packages: 0 files name `UnifiedViewConfig`. Control `@object-ui/types` or `ListChartConfigSchema` inside the `@objectstack/*` packages: 37 files.
- **NOT MEASURED:** host applications built on the published package (production apps, hotcrm, cloud).

No named consumer turned up, so there is no stop and no re-shape.

## Tombstone shape (H3)

This follows the house pattern for a type member: `?: never` with a RETIRED docblock and `@deprecated` naming the remedy, the shape of `ObjectGridSchema.resizableColumns` (objectui#6152 round 7) and of the `designer.ts` tombstones (`parentId`, `autoLayout`, `previewMode`). The retire-vs-remove discriminator in `complex.ts` puts a tombstone on a surviving carrier when it steers to a live replacement or a deletion would keep the key silently. Both hold here. The remedy is the spec block, and `UnifiedViewConfig` keeps `[key: string]: any`, so a deleted member reads `any` and admits every value; ablation R2 below measures that. The interface has no zod mirror, so there is no `retirementTombstone` half to write.

## The three messages and their pin (H4)

The three arms sit under the objectui#10608 comment block in `ObjectChartSchema`. One pin reads them: `object-chart-legacy-axis-keys-retired-10608.test.ts`. It asserts:

- the envelope: one `invalid_type` at the key;
- that the message carries the key in backticks and the remedy's spelling;
- that the message equals the published `.describe()` text;
- in block (c), the `function` vocabulary it PARSES out of the `aggregation` message, against the spec's `ChartAggregateSchema`.

It does not pin the dropped clause, and no test reads the `objectql.ts` docblocks: the pin's block (f) reads types only, and the tests that read `objectql.ts` off disk assert other members. Under the rule that message text is pinned only where a consumer parses it, the clause is not contract. So the pin needs no edit, and no new assertion pins the new wording. The parsed `function` list is byte-identical. Ablation R3 confirms the pin does not read the clause.

## Reverse verification (one-time, committed first)

Each leg ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Its own EXIT/INT/TERM trap held the mutation, the anchor hit exactly once, and the write was verified on disk by blob change. A belt trap restored both files from `HEAD` by absolute path. No `dist` is involved: the pin imports `../designer` and `../zod/objectql.zod` from source. The predicted direction is in brackets.

- **R1** revives the old object type [red]: TS2344 on the tombstone row, plus TS2578 (unused directive) on the legacy row and the widened row.
- **R2** deletes the member instead of the tombstone [red]: TS2344, plus TS2578 on all three directive rows. The index signature admits `chart` as `any`.
- **R4** re-shapes the member to `ListChartConfig` instead of retiring it [red]: TS2344, plus TS2578 on the dataset-shaped row.
- **R3** restores "is the list-view chart block's spelling" in the `xAxisField` message [green, by design]: the 10608 pin passes, 24 of 24.
- After every leg, blob equals `HEAD` for both files and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

A first R1 at `f07e75c` showed the widened row passing for a second reason: a readonly `as const` value is refused by the old type too. `ad25686` makes that row's value mutable, and R1 at `ad25686` turns it red.

## Gates at `ad25686` (first round)

  - Each run printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter='...@object-ui/types' --concurrency=2 --continue`, under the lock: `@object-ui/types` and its 41 downstream packages. Each one echoed its hyphenated `type-check` script. `Tasks: 77 successful, 77 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 3 changed TS files: exit 0, 0 errors. `designer.ts` warnings went from 10 to 7, because the retired block's three `any` are gone. The new pin carries 1 `no-explicit-any`, the row that asserts `any` on purpose. The population comes from `eslint.config.js` `files` globs (`**/*.{ts,tsx}`). The config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project`), so an untouched file's verdict cannot move. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Changeset gates, exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` ("3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite` and `check-pending-changeset-literals`.
- Exit 0: `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check-control-bytes`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-spec-symbol-derivation`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-action-ref-convention` and `check-pre-install-import-graph`.

## Patch round 1: the `objectql.ts` docblock twins

The claim first named only the zod messages. The first round's report raised the three docblocks as the same clause on the TypeScript face, and the seat amended the claim to add `objectql.ts` (`6084083560`). The in-place fix meets all four conditions:

- the same defect class: the same clause, on the twin of the same three tombstones;
- mechanical: drop the clause, keep each remedy and its `@deprecated` line;
- no other claim or open PR touches `objectql.ts` (the seat's reading on `main` at `2a48bd4`);
- the same gate family: `packages/types`.

Body refreshed for patch round 1 at 2026-10-09T15:39Z. Gates at `dc8e887`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`, under the lock: exit 0. It echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` and printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: exit 0, 0 errors; 26 warnings, the same as on `main` at `2a48bd4`.
- Changeset gates, exit 0: presence ("4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), no-major, fixed, claims, overwrite and pending-changeset-literals.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"): exit 0.
- The downstream type-check was not re-run. Docblock text changes no type, so the 42-package run at `ad25686` still covers every type this PR publishes.

## Acceptance notes

1. The `UnifiedViewConfig` interface docblock says "Used by ViewConfigPanel (create/edit)". The census reads no import of the type anywhere. That is out of this card's scope, which is the `chart` member only. Noted, not changed.
2. The same census shows that nothing in reach imports the exported `UnifiedViewConfig` interface at all, not only its `chart` member. This is an observation with no carrier; only `chart` was this card's to retire.
